lines.en: Additional trivia factoid, this food comes to us through Val, and our server is none other than Brandon, her boyf.
Jamaican, huh? I just read about the elections down there. Crazy stuff.
Oh, no, I'm not actually Jamaican.
Now, Daryl, I heard about you. You doing good?
You must be doing real good since you're f***ing my girlfriend.
Dude, you didn't tell me you were f***ing Val.
I'm not sleeping with your girlfriend.
Brandon, what the hell are you talking about?
Don't play dumb with me. I know what's up.
Let's get back to the food. Brandon, tell us about these delicious-looking goops.
I read the text you sent to Val, man.
No, baby girl. It would be messed up if I didn't find anything, but I did, so...
I'm not sure if Daryl sent Val a text, it was about some paper emergency or something.
It happens. Like a hospital needs more napkins for surgery.
Guys, we're not going to settle anything this way. I think we just need to be grown-ups here.
I think we're going to need to hear those texts.
Okay, Ellie. Remember how you wanted to go home before?
There's no way in hell I'm leaving.
Something interesting is happening here for once in my life.
I got too much ice cream. You want some?
Oh, gosh. The moon one's damning.
You're such a great friend. Dot, dot, dot, dot, dot.
Five dots, Daryl? Are you kidding me?
Okay, because three dots means to be continued. Four dots is a typo, but five dots means,
Whoa. Do not make me say what I want to say, baby, but if I did, it would blow your mind. Dot, dot, dot, dot, dot.
Brandon, Daryl and me, it's ridiculous. Right?
Puts me in an insane asylum just thinking about it.
I'm stranded on Shutter Island over here.
Puts me in an insane asylum.
